highlights: Luggage Scale - Yesido MG41 50kg Capacity Digital Handheld Luggage Weight Scale with LCD Display
✅ Accurate Weighing Performance: Thanks to its high-precision sensors, it weighs your suitcase with the utmost accuracy.
✅ 50 KG Wide Weighing Capacity: With a wide weighing range capable of measuring up to 50 kg, it is suitable for all types of luggage, from small bags to large suitcases.
✅ 3 Different Units of Measurement (kg / lb / oz): Ideal for international travel with kg, lb and oz options for ease of use in different countries.
✅ Clear Image with LED Digital Display: Thanks to its high-resolution LED screen, it displays weight values clearly, brightly, and in an easy-to-read format.
✅ Target Weight Setting and Excess Weight Warning: By setting your desired weight limit in advance, you can easily check if your luggage is excessive.
✅ One-Touch Reset Feature: Allows you to measure only the net baggage weight by resetting additional weights.
